rules.text: Evidence about another printer asset establishes nothing about the current printer.
A stale note (older than a later state change) does not establish current state.
Contradictory current indications of one property leave it unresolved; no indication is preferred by recency or source alone.
A commanded or attempted action is not completion; only a verification establishes a completed step.
With thermal-transfer media established and print method direct thermal, setting the print method to thermal transfer is justified.
With direct-thermal media established and print method thermal transfer, setting the print method to direct thermal is justified.
Thermal-transfer printing needs a loaded ribbon: with no ribbon established, loading one is justified and returning to printing is prohibited.
A current media/ribbon detection symptom with consistent configuration justifies starting manual sensor calibration or verifying the loading.
Continuing a calibration prompt requires verified completion of that prompt's step; continuing without it is prohibited.
Cancelling calibration leaves calibration incomplete; it is justified when calibration runs under a configuration inconsistent with the media.

Returning to printing is prohibited during calibration, after an unverified or cancelled calibration with a current symptom, or with configuration inconsistent with the media; it is justified when paused with consistent configuration and no unaddressed symptom.
An attempted but unverified loading or calibration step justifies verifying it.
When a decision depends on an unresolved property, requesting that observation is justified.
An action no rule justifies is not justified.

applicability.models: ZT411 and ZT421, as titled by user guide P1106464-07EN Rev A
applicability.options: ribbon and thermal-transfer rules (ZT-RIBBON, ZT-METHOD-TT) apply only to printers with the Thermal Transfer option installed (guide p. 11)
applicability.firmware: the guide's firmware section (p. 31) asks to verify Link-OS 7.0 or later and recommends Printer OS v92; it states no firmware dependence for the cited procedures; no installed printer's firmware is established
applicability.claim: decisions are claims about the documented procedure of this edition, not about any particular installed printer
